writeup: TIC 239661046 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 1.0540 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse causing a 6.25% dimming of the star's light, while no secondary eclipse was detected. The eclipse signal shows strong statistical evidence with a signal-to-noise ratio of 889.2 in the periodogram analysis. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the signal at the target location with a peak signal-to-noise of 63.0, though the centroid offset measures 1.4 arcsec from the nominal target position. The candidate does not appear in any of six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel candidate from automated TESS analysis. The machine learning model assigned a screening score of 0.95, indicating high confidence that this represents a real target.
